comparison_variable: source-measured cumulative parked seconds in each covered rolling hour
fixed_conditions: same surveyed alley, vehicle, lawful-parking source review and camera setup
same rolling-window measurement and civil/Native time join
same parking pose; separate source ledger target duration varies
native_source_requirements: original Native map and surveyed alley boundary
original vehicle identity and parking intervals spanning at least one hour
original civil/Native time join and nonoverlapping intervals
independent source review of otherwise-lawful parking under other rules
600 original Native capture frames with all four source-camera joins

source_observation_terms_mapped.st.alley: source-surveyed alley boundary and original map
source_observation_terms_mapped.drv.standing_or_parked: source-ledger intervals of the same vehicle parked within the alley
source_observation_terms_mapped.kin.time: parked interval start/end timestamps integrated over rolling windows
source_observation_terms_mapped.env.civil_time: civil/Native time source and capture-to-ledger join
source_observation_terms_mapped.rel.occupies: source alley occupancy for every parked interval and capture frame
source_observation_terms_mapped.kin.position: vehicle identity and position history retained across moves; move does not reset rolling time
